name: typesafe-tools
description: Bounded Jev evaluation, capability routing, and computer-use action advice for eligible tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Route eligible tasks and advise on computer-use actions.
interface.longDescription: Jev ranks available skills and tools for eligible public or synthetic tasks. An optional computer-use pilot reuses bounded browser and native-app action code while Codex reviews advice and verifies results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check TypeSafe readiness and route an eligible public or synthetic task among available capabilities.
